description: Supply request queue visible to guests - guests can see what supplies have been requested, where their request stands in line, where supplies have been or will be delivered, who is delivering (host name by default), and status.
steps: Create a new guest API route at src/app/api/party/[guestCode]/requests/supplies/route.ts that returns all SUPPLY-category requests for the party, ordered by createdAt ascending (FIFO queue). Include fields: id, item, deliveryType, deliveryValue, status, createdAt, location (from relation). Also return the party name (as the default 'deliverer' since host name is the party name).

Create a new guest component at src/components/guest/SupplyQueue.tsx that displays the supply request queue with sections: (1) 'Being Delivered' - SEEN requests showing item, delivery destination (location name or person name), and 'Delivered by: [party name]', (2) 'In Queue' - NEW requests showing position, item, and destination, (3) 'Delivered' - DONE requests. Highlight the current user's request(s) with a distinct visual style showing their queue position.
The SupplyQueue component should subscribe to SSE events ('request-update', 'new-request') via the existing guest events endpoint to update the queue in real-time.
Update the guest party API at src/app/api/party/[guestCode]/route.ts to include the party name in the response (it already does - field name is available).

Integrate the SupplyQueue into the guest flow: After a supply request is submitted, show the SupplyQueue below the RequestTracker. Also add a 'View Queue' link under the Supply button on the category selection page.
Update src/app/party/[guestCode]/page.tsx to add a 'Supply Queue' view accessible from the main category selection screen and shown after supply request submission.
acceptance_criteria: Guests can see all supply requests ordered first-come-first-served
Each supply request shows: item name, delivery destination (location or person), status, and deliverer (party/host name)
The guest's own request is visually highlighted in the queue
SEEN requests show as 'Being Delivered' with the host/party name as deliverer
DONE requests appear in a 'Delivered' section
Queue updates in real-time via SSE
The queue is accessible from both the category selection and after submitting a supply request
verification: Run npm run build and confirm it succeeds with no TypeScript errors
Run npm test and confirm all tests pass
findings: Build and tests pass. Supply queue API at /api/party/[guestCode]/requests/supplies returns SUPPLY-category requests with location join and partyName. SupplyQueue component shows Being Delivered (SEEN), In Queue (NEW with position numbers), and Delivered (DONE) sections. Highlights current user's requests via myRequestIds prop. SSE events (request-update, new-request) drive real-time updates. Supply queue accessible from category selection screen via subtle link and shown below RequestTracker after supply submission.
